{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/25bcee0bf794ad45c9afa5d21d5de6cdcd517716.jpg

Pilots!

On September 10, from 08:00 to 12:00 UTC, the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy Update 2.1.35
New Aircraft
https://worldofwarplanes.eu/dcont/fb/imagesforarticles/releasewipe/prize_premium_plane_684x112.jpg
Update 2.1.35 will introduce two brand-new reward aircraft:

 Messerschmitt Bf 109 G-6N Gustav, a German Tier VII fighter
 Grumman F9F Panther, an American Tier IX multirole fighter
The Messerschmitt Bf 109 G-6N is a night-fighter variant of the famed Gustav, equipped with underwing Rüstsatz VI pods containing MG 151/20 autocannons. This, in combination with a hub-mounted 30 mm autocannon and two 13 mm synchronized machine guns, common to most other Bf 109 G variants, provides a more dense firing volley than the Tech Tree version Bf 109 G has in its top configuration. It is noticeably more accurate than the Bf 109 K-6, although, naturally, it has less firepower. The longer burst length and higher muzzle velocity of the cannons make aiming and tracking targets rather easy, though the underwing pods suffer from slightly reduced accuracy. Its reduced weight also provides a minuscule boost in cruise speed and maneuverability.

The Grumman F9F Panther is a formidable Tier IX multirole fighter, capable of engaging enemies at range and outshooting nearly any opponent of its class. Its battery of four nose-mounted Colt Mk 12 autocannons provides devastating firepower at medium and close ranges, making the Panther extremely dangerous in direct engagements. And it has ground-pounding capabilities to boot: six late-model HVAR rockets and two 500-pound bombs that pack a serious punch! Its airframe is on par with the armament: the Panther is highly durable, resistant to critical damage, and surprisingly maneuverable. Its main weakness is its engine, an early jet design that is capable of rather average speed and thrust characteristics, which may make hit-and-run attacks difficult. But who cares about that if you can just weather the storm of a blistering dogfight?

To earn these aircraft, you'll need to participate in the upcoming game events.

https://worldofwarplanes.eu/dcont/fb/imagesforarticles/releasewipe/prize_premium_plane_684x112.jpg
Update 2.1.34 will introduce a brand-new reward aircraft—Kawanishi J6K1 Jinpu, the Japanese Tier VII fighter.

The Kawanishi J6K "Jinpu" was designed as a prospective land-based heavy interceptor, drawing on the previous J3K design. Initially, there were plans to equip it with the Mitsubishi Ha-43/MK9 engine, but delays in its production forced the designers at Kawanishi to switch to the Nakajima Ha-45/NK9. This prompted additional changes to the design, which resulted in the J6K1 version of the aircraft. By 1944, it reached a mockup phase of development, but was eventually abandoned in favour of more promising designs.

The Kawanishi J6K1 in World of Warplanes is a fast and extremely dangerous fighter. Its six wing-mounted 20 millimeter cannons can shred any target in seconds at medium range, although they will require careful aiming and heat management from the pilot. The J6K1 departs somewhat from the typical Japanese fighter aircraft, sacrificing some maneuverability for better speed. In the hands of a skilled player, it will become a formidable threat to aircraft of any class.

To earn the Kawanishi J6K1 Jinpu, you'll need to participate in an upcoming event.

notes.title: Update 2.1.33
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/25bcee0bf794ad45c9afa5d21d5de6cdcd517716.jpg

Pilots!

On May 7, from 08:00 to 12:00 UTC, the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy Update 2.1.33
New Aircraft
https://worldofwarplanes.eu/dcont/fb/imagesforarticles/releasewipe/prize_premium_plane_684x112.jpg
Update 2.1.33 will introduce a brand-new reward aircraft—Grumman F8F-2 Bearcat, the American Tier VII multirole fighter.

Designed after the Battle of Midway, this fighter's primary improvements over its predecessor and "big brother", the F6F Hellcat, were an increased rate of climb and better maneuverability. The Bearcat was powered by the same Pratt & Whitney R-2800, the most powerful American piston engine at the time, yet significantly smaller and lighter. As a result, it best functioned as an interceptor, capable of a quick takeoff, climb to altitude, and engagement. With the first production aircraft delivered to the Navy in 1945, the Bearcat didn't see combat in World War II. However, it did serve as the primary fighter for the US Navy and Marines until it was finally surpassed by the early jet-powered fighters—the Grumman F9F Panthers, in particular.

The late-model Grumman F8F-2 Bearcat is an American Tier VII multirole fighter that boasts significantly better maneuverability and rate of climb than its counterparts from the Corsair family. A small frame makes this aircraft harder to hit, while its four 20-mm autocannons are more than enough to fight back enemies in the sky. And with a variable outboard armament, offering a choice between a 1,000-pound bomb or a rack of HVAR rockets, this aircraft does pack a punch!

To earn the Grumman F8F-2 Bearcat, you'll need to participate in an upcoming event.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/25bcee0bf794ad45c9afa5d21d5de6cdcd517716.jpg

Pilots!

New Aircraft
https://worldofwarplanes.eu/dcont/fb/imagesforarticles/releasewipe/prize_premium_plane_684x112.jpg
Update 2.1.32 will introduce a brand-new reward aircraft—Avro Lancaster B Mk. III, the British Tier VI bomber.

The Avro Lancaster heavy bomber was a legendary Allied aircraft in the European theater of World War II, responsible for numerous iconic operations and audacious raids against German industry. Lancasters helped sink battleship Tirpitz in the fjords of Norway and gained eternal glory in Operation Chastise, when 19 of these specially modified warbirds from the Royal Air Force's Number 617 Squadron sneaked into the Ruhr Valley and successfully damaged several river dams in the region.

The Lancaster B Mk. III in World of Warplanes is a British Tier VI bomber that brings immense demolishing power to the battlefield. Slow and lumbering, this flying giant won't be the first to reach the enemy base, but when it does, it will unleash its fifteen 500 lb (227 kg) bombs in volleys that can turn even the strongest opponents into rubble. Though lacking in speed, this aircraft is in no way defenseless. Its four defensive turrets cover all directions, with twin-mounted Browning Mk II machine guns on the nose, dorsal, and ventral turrets, along with four more on the rear turret.
To earn this aircraft, you'll need to participate in an upcoming game event.

notes.title: Holiday Maneuvers
notes.content:
https://worldofwarplanes.eu/dcont/fb/image/holiday_maneuvers_2025_684x243.png

December is here, so it's time to decorate a tree, turn on the fairy lights, and, of course, accept some gifts. Immerse yourself in the holiday bustle with the new Operation Holiday Maneuvers event!

Join the jolly winter marathon and collect candy to get Premium aircraft, days of Premium Account, gold, and much more as a reward!

The holiday event will run from December 18 (08:00 UTC) till January 15 (08:00 UTC).

Complete daily missions and get the most out of each battle to collect a whole load of candy. Advancing along the marathon route depends directly on the amount of candy you have. Every candy piece you earn moves you closer to the coveted reward!

You can get candy by participating in battles and completing daily missions:

 Easy daily mission – 3 pieces of candy
 Average daily mission – 6 pieces of candy
 Difficult daily mission – 9 pieces of candy
 Over 8,000 personal points earned in a single complete battle will grant you +1 candy

Certificates within the Holiday Maneuvers event will be available for purchase in the Premium Shop from 13:00 UTC on December 18.

If there is candy left after getting all the rewards, it will be converted into Free XP at a rate of 100 Free XP points for 1 piece of candy.

Update 2.1.30 introduces a brand-new reward aircraft–the American Tier VIII bomber Douglas XB-42 Mixmaster.

The Douglas XB-42 Mixmaster was an independent proposal by the manufacturer to design a long-range heavy bomber with a range similar to the Boeing B-29 Superfortress. This was achieved by placing two engines inside the fuselage and installing a pair of contra-rotating propellers in the tail in a pusher configuration. This design drastically reduced aerodynamic drag, which resulted in high speed, good altitude performance, and extended operational range. Two prototypes of the XB-42 were built and tested extensively, but the advent of the jet era caused the USAAF to put the project aside.

In World of Warplanes, the Douglas XB-42 Mixmaster is a Tier VIII bomber with good speed and altitude characteristics, carrying a large bomb load of twelve 500-pound bombs, released in three salvos. Its reasonably quick bomb reload time allows the XB-42 to engage in tactical bombing, traversing between targets and arriving at them with a full rack. A good rate of climb and a high operational ceiling offer safety from most hunters. All this provides for a more dynamic and engaged bomber gameplay than most players are used to.

Update 2.1.29 introduces a brand-new reward aircraft–the Italian Tier VII heavy fighter Savoia-Marchetti SM.91.

Designed in 1942 for the Regia Aeronautica Italiana, this heavy fighter was one of the most advanced at the time. It featured an all-metal fuselage and wings that provided maximum rigidity for better performance. The aircraft was powered by two ubiquitous Daimler-Benz DB 605 engines (produced by Fiat under license). The main strength of its design was the armament: the SM.91 boasted five 20 mm MG 151/20 autocannons, three mounted in the nose cowling and two more—near the wing roots. The aircraft's defensive capability was provided by a small turret with another MG 151. Two prototypes were produced and undergoing testing until they were passed into German possession in 1943 and eventually lost.

In World of Warplanes, Savoia-Marchetti SM.91 is a Tier VII Italian heavy fighter (belonging to the European meta-nation). The SM.91 is not the fastest or most maneuverable of its peers, but it has great altitude characteristics. The autocannon battery combines a good rate of fire and solid damage, is relatively easy to aim, and provides a convenient firing pattern between accurate nose-mounted cannons and the wider firing line of the wing-mounted ones. Overall, this makes it an excellent warplane for boom-and-zoom tactics and strafing runs. The SM.91 also carries a small bomb load that can be employed for pinpoint strikes on AA positions or smaller ground targets.

Update 2.1.28 introduces a brand-new reward aircraft–the Japanese Tier VII bomber Mitsubishi G4M2.

A staple of the Imperial Japanese Navy's bomber operations, this was one of the most effective and widely used medium bombers of World War II. Virtually every battle in the Pacific saw participation from the G4M, which the U.S. pilots and soldiers had nicknamed Betty. The first models also carried more sinister nicknames from Japanese pilots, who called them the G4M Hamaki (cigar), and American counterparts, who referred to them as the Flying Lighter—both denoting their propensity to easily catch fire. The G4M2 model was improved significantly in terms of aircraft and crew survivability, including self-sealing fuel tanks, armor panels in crew compartments, and much stronger defensive armament.

Mitsubishi G4M2 in World of Warplanes is a slow but rather durable bomber with heavy defensive armament, including two 20 mm autocannons that cover the upper and aft hemispheres. The G4M2's bomb load consists of four 250 kg bombs with a relatively quick reload period, so it doesn't need to disengage from its main activity for long periods of time.

New Aircraft
https://worldofwarplanes.eu/dcont/fb/imagesforarticles/releasewipe/prize_premium_plane_684x112.jpg
Update 2.1.24 introduces a brand-new reward aircraft:

  Martin-Baker MB 5, a British Tier VII fighter

Martin-Baker MB 5 was the ultimate result of a programme ordered by the British Air Ministry to develop a replacement fighter for the Spitfire and Hurricane. It was expected to be capable of flying faster than 400 miles per hour and be well armed to serve in a variety of combat roles. Designed from the ground up, the MB 5 featured a new Rolls-Royce Griffon engine, a contra-rotating propeller scheme, and four wing-mounted 20-mm Hispano autocannons. The prototype was built in 1944 and was considered to be superior to Supermarine Spitfire by its test pilots. Unfortunately, it was not ready for mass production quickly enough before the Air Ministry's focus shifted towards jet-powered aircraft, and eventually the project was abandoned.

In World of Warplanes, Martin-Baker MB 5 is a fast and maneuverable fighter with a characteristically easy to use medium-range autocannon armament. It has a significant speed advantage over its Spitfire counterparts at Tier VII, which allows it to dictate the terms of engagement to a wider score of enemies. Its autocannons remain characteristically comfortable to use in close-range dogfights and medium-range combat, boasting good damage, range, rate of fire, and accuracy. However, the Martin-Baker MB 5 will require a bit more care and piloting skill from the player to fully reveal its combat potential, as, being a prototype, it is more prone to critical damage and fires.

To earn this warplane, you'll need to participate in the upcoming game event.

notes.content:

Pilots!

From September 13 at 11:20 UTC through October 11 at 11:20 UTC, a chain of 25 missions awaits you. For their completion, you'll receive a new aircraft— North American P-51D Josephine—and other valuable rewards!
[previewyoutube=EdooVTVP8jQ;full][/previewyoutube]We are honored to add this Tier VII premium US fighter to our game to commemorate the deeds of one of the last surviving combat pilots of World War II - Colonel Joseph Anthony Peterburs. 

It was in the cockpit of Josephine - his trusty Mustang named after his beloved fiancée - that on April 10, 1945 Joe encountered and shot down the formidable Messerschmitt Me 262 piloted by the famed German flying ace Walther Schuck. You can learn more about that encounter, and check out our interview with the veteran at the official website.

While technically the in-game Josephine is a regular North American P-51D Mustang, it has all the advantages of a premium aircraft, with increased earnings of credits and XP in battle, and sports the top-tier armament and engine. But what makes it unique is its exclusive livery: based on the historical photographs we've obtained from multiple sources, including Joe Peterburs himself, it provides a hefty set of advantages in battle:

Concealment: +20%Resistance to damage from AA guns: +10%Resistance to damage from gunners: +5%Aircraft XP: +8%Chance to cause fire: +15%
Note:
You may skip missions of the marathon by purchasing certificates in the Premium Shop.
Only Tier IV–X aircraft can take part in the event.

You can find more details about the chain of missions on our official portal!

Keep completing marathon missions on your favorite warbirds to grab all the event's rewards! Don't have time to complete all the missions? Just visit the Premium Shop and purchase certificates to speed up the completion of the in-game event!

Update 2.1.23 introduces a brand-new reward aircraft:

  North American P-51D Josephine, an American Tier VII fighter


This aircraft is a tribute to one of World War II's last surviving combat pilots—the USAF Colonel Joseph Anthony Peterburs. He has flown 49 missions over Europe since 1944, piloting his trusty Mustang named after his beloved fiancée Josephine. On April 10, 1945, Joe was escorting a huge bomber raid toward Berlin when a Messerschmitt Me 262 swooped down on the B-17s, wreaking havoc on the formation and destroying four aircraft. Having an altitude advantage over the "Swallow," Joe dove at his target and opened fire with his machine guns, riddling the wing and engine with bullets. The Me 262 disengaged and withdrew inside cloud cover, and its pilot, famed German flying ace Walther Schuck, bailed out. Over half a century later, during Schuck's visit to the United States in 2005, Joe Peterburs had the opportunity to meet and befriend his former enemy, discussing the details of that short but fateful encounter. They remained close friends until Walther Schuck's passing in 2015.

notes.title: Transfer Opportunities for Players from CIS to the EU Realm
notes.content:
Dear players!

On June 15, we announced that on December 13, 2022 operations of World of Warplanes in the CIS region will be stopped.

The next big step is to launch a special CIS → EU transfer campaign for CIS players who wish to continue playing World of Warplanes.

Despite the fact that the account transfer opportunity will be available for a prolonged period of time, after the CIS server of World of Warplanes will be shut down on December 13, 2022, we cannot guarantee that the World of Warplanes account data will remain available for transfer to the EU servers. If you wish to take advantage of the account transfer, we recommend completing it before December 13, 2022.

Below you can find the key points about this procedure:

 In September, CIS servers will be turned off for Steam players. Additionally, new players from Russia and Belarus will not be able to register a new World of Warplanes account via Steam.
 New CIS players from outside Russia and Belarus will still be able to install World of Warplanes in Steam and create an account. Such players will be automatically redirected to EU region during registration.
 If you already have an account on CIS region, you will have an opportunity to transfer your CIS account to EU region and continue playing on Steam.
 If you don’t want to transfer your account to EU region, unfortunately, you will not be able to continue playing on Steam.

Providing high quality service and ensuring the comfort of our players will always remain our priority. We will keep your account progress and all applicable terms and conditions, including pricing principles, as well as the core set of services you are used to, no matter where you continue playing.

Additional questions

[expand type=showmore]
Q: Do I need to perform any actions now?
A: If you wish to transfer your account, make sure that you have completed your registration by adding an email and a password. Other than that, you do not have to do anything now, this is just an announcement to make sure you stay up to date with our latest plans. We will make an additional publication when the transfer is ready with all details about the procedure.

Q: How long will the transfer option be available?
A: The transfer campaign doesn’t have any planned end date. We want to make sure that all our players get a chance to move to EU region, including those who decided to take a break from the game at the moment. Nevertheless, once the CIS server of World of Warplanes is stopped on December 13, 2022, we cannot guarantee that your account data will be saved, therefore we recommend completing the account transfer before that date. 

Q: Will my progress, stats, purchases and resources be transferred as well?
A: Yes, of course. Your progress, stats, purchases, resources etc. will be transferred to a new account on EU region. We will give you all the details closer to the transfer start.

Q: I play from Belarus or Russia and I want to transfer my account to EU region. Will I be able to make purchases in the game after the transfer?
A: You will not be able to pay directly to Wargaming. In order to know if you are able to make purchases directly to Steam, please look at the payment methods that are available in your country on Steam or contact Steam Support.

Q: Will the prices in the in-game Store become higher after the transfer?
A: For the transferred players, the pricing principles on EU region will remain at the same level with CIS region.

Q: Will my ping become worse after the transfer?
A: This is a very specific question which depends on a variety of factors, mainly on your service provider and your location. In some cases it might become lower, in other cases it might become higher.

Q: Can I transfer my EU, NA, ASIA account to another server during this transfer campaign?
A: No, this transfer campaign will be aimed specifically at CIS-region players. Other regions remain without any changes.

Q: What if I don’t want to transfer my account to EU region?
A: Unfortunately, in that case, you will not be able to play World of Warplanes via Steam on your CIS-region account.
[/expand]

We understand that this is a big and serious decision for our players, and we will do our best to make it a smooth and easy experience for everyone.

notes.content:

On June 29, from 01:00 PT / 04:00 ET to 05:00 PT / 08:00 ET, the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy Update 2.1.14.


Magpie Supply Crate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/efa603e07e92a2192fd150b6c3aaa79cf35f39ba.png
Magpie Supply Crates will be added to the game. They will focus on materials and contain three guaranteed prizes: days of Premium Account, gold, materials, Free XP, consumables, or pilots with five skill points. You can purchase them in the Premium Shop or earn them as a reward for in-game activities.

Aircraft
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/678505cf33ba9f56504683af1643c9e5c2bf9276.jpg

Update 2.1.14 introduces a brand-new reward aircraft:
 P-38L Lightning, an American Tier VI heavy fighter.
This is an experimental configuration of the valiant P-38 that has noticeably increased ground attack capabilities due to additional HVAR rockets. Also, the Lightning has increased potential in aerial combat thanks to three 15 mm machine guns that allow it to engage enemies from further afield.

To earn it, you'll have to take part in the marathon for the P-38L Lightning.

Marathon for P-38L Lightning
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/b724d00357f67d2f045d195ceb5c53db83843de7.jpg

notes.title: Update 2.1.13
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/25bcee0bf794ad45c9afa5d21d5de6cdcd517716.jpg

On May 4, from 01:00 PT / 04:00 ET to 05:00 PT / 08:00 ET, the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy Update 2.1.13.


New Supply Crate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/efe96405cbf5a418a9beb96fdf184853747886bd.png

Harpy Supply Crates will be added to the game. They will contain three guaranteed prizes: days of Premium Account, Premium aircraft, gold, Free XP, consumables, equipment, pilots with three skill points, or materials. You can purchase them in the Premium Shop or get them as a reward for in-game activities.

If the supply crate drops an aircraft that you already have, you'll get a one-time compensation of gold.

In addition, you're now guaranteed to get a valuable reward when opening your 25th, 50th, 75th, and 100th supply crate.

Optimization of Daily Missions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/f1c8d300266f26b33e39957eb1af64c2a465e785.jpg

Update 2.1.13 will bring changes to the following missions: Fast and Deadly, Hail From Heaven, Bringing Terror, Hall of Fame, Agility and Might, Impetuous Attack, Might Makes Right, Commendation, Solo Artist, Caution and Determination, Sharp Claws, First Star, Major Priority, Sweet Revenge, Strategist, Lucky Number, Price of Victory, and Sting Like a Hornet.

We removed the requirement to win the battle for all of these missions. We also changed other conditions for some of them.

New Paint Schemes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/945a96c5c5bcad83cec7d99025b592bce7a6a33b.jpg

We added new paint schemes for the following popular airplanes: Junkers Ju 287 (German Tier IX bomber)
 Tupolev Tu-12 (Soviet Tier IX bomber)
 Junkers/OKB-1 EF 131 (German Tier X bomber)
 Messerschmitt Me P.1102 B (German Tier X attack aircraft)
 Sukhoi Su-10 (Soviet Tier X bomber)
Paint scheme characteristics: Concealment: +20%
 Tolerance to damage from AA guns: +10%
 Tolerance to damage from gunners: +5%
 Aircraft experience: +5%
These paint schemes will become available in future Premium Shop offers and as rewards during game events.

Boosters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/9ea3bd65bc0efc718efe1ca239797beb9509fe2d.png

We will significantly increase the variety of boosters that can be purchased for gold. Soon you'll see the following boosters: Upgrade Implementation: +100% to aircraft XP for 4 hours (cost: 300)
 Upgrade Implementation: +150% to aircraft XP for 2 hours (cost: 350 gold)
 Air Reconnaissance: +300% to Free XP for 4 hours (cost: 300 gold)
 Air Reconnaissance: +450% to Free XP for 2 hours (cost: 350 gold)
 Intensive Training: +300% to crew XP for 4 hours (cost: 300 gold)
 Intensive Training: +450% to Crew XP for 2 hours (cost: 350 gold)
 Procurement System Improvement: +100% to credits for 4 hours (cost: 300 gold)
 Procurement System Improvement: +150% to credits for 2 hours (cost: 350 gold)
Other
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/8acfe469a7ff603db3e9023877bc9b38e58500bf.jpg
 The bug that occurred when crediting unique pilots was fixed. You can now receive them as a reward for completing missions.
 The size of the Equipment section in the Depot was increased. In the past, an error would occur when players reached the maximum amount of equipment on their accounts.
 The system of filters for aircraft in the Hangar was changed. Players will now be able to do "negative filtering."

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/eb44bb2dee6d19cc6ee865e2d516e53472c7b257.png

Update 2.1.12 introduces a new aircraft, the  Supermarine Spitfire XVI!

It's the iconic Spitfire, modified for battles on low altitudes. Featuring enhanced maneuverability and speed, this warplane can effectively engage enemy fighters and protect friendly attack aircraft and ground objects.

From February 21 (03:20 PT / 06:20 ET) to March 21 (04:20 PT / 07:20 ET), complete a chain of 25 missions to receive the Supermarine Spitfire XVI and a decoration set (paint scheme, nose art, emblem) for your new warbird!

Note

 You may skip combat missions of the marathon by purchasing certificates in the Premium Shop;
 Only Tier IV – X aircraft can take part in the event.


You can find more details about the chain of missions on our official portal!

Keep completing marathon missions on your favorite warbirds to grab all the event's rewards! Don't have time to complete all the missions? Just visit the Premium Shop and purchase certificates to speed up the completion of the in-game event!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/25bcee0bf794ad45c9afa5d21d5de6cdcd517716.jpg

On February 9, from 00:00 PT / 03:00 ET to 04:00 PT / 07:00 ET, the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy Update 2.1.12.


Aircraft
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/678505cf33ba9f56504683af1643c9e5c2bf9276.jpg

Update 2.1.12 introduces a brand-new reward aircraft:
 Supermarine Spitfire XVI, a British Tier VII fighter.
It's the iconic Spitfire, modified for battles on low altitudes. Featuring enhanced maneuverability and speed, this warplane can effectively engage enemy fighters and protect friendly attack aircraft and ground objects.

To earn it, you'll have to take part in the marathon for the Supermarine Spitfire XVI.

Marathon for Supermarine Spitfire XVI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/b724d00357f67d2f045d195ceb5c53db83843de7.jpg

February will bring a new event to World of Warplanes. Complete marathon missions to get multiple prizes, including days of Premium Account, Steel Supply Crates, tokens, and much more. The main reward is the Supermarine Spitfire XVI, a British Premium fighter.

To speed up your progress through the marathon, you'll be able to skip missions for certificates.

Map Layouts
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/945a96c5c5bcad83cec7d99025b592bce7a6a33b.jpg

 There's now a 50% lower chance of being sent to the following locations: Arctic Region: Fire and Ice
 Archipelago: Decisive Blow

 Scorching Sands: Desert Wind There's now a 30% lower chance of being sent to the following locations: Sea Gate: Siege

 Old Fortress: Enemy at the Gates
 Old Fortress: Danger Zone
 Archipelago: Retaliation
 Peripheral Mission: Harsh Times

Other
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/8acfe469a7ff603db3e9023877bc9b38e58500bf.jpg

 Added themed emblems dedicated to Valentine's Day and International Women's Day. You'll be able to obtain them during the relevant in-game activities.
 Added a decorations set (paint scheme, nose art, emblem) for the Supermarine Spitfire XVI aircraft.
 Fixed a bug, which in some cases prevented players from boosting pilot training for Free XP.
 Added an achievement for those who manage to earn the Supermarine Spitfire XVI.
 Added a themed emblem for warplanes. To obtain it, get a DLC in Steam.
 Implemented support for Chinese language.

notes.title: Holiday Maneuvers
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/2b26e2ab8df0e150cce594d34b5669135e447e8c.png

December is here, so it's time to decorate a tree, turn on the fairy lights, and, of course, accept some gifts. Immerse yourself in the holiday bustle with the new Operation Holiday Maneuvers event!

Join the jolly winter marathon and collect candy to get Premium aircraft, days of Premium Account, gold, and much more as a reward!

The holiday event will run from December 15 (04:00 PT / 07:00 ET) till January 19 (00:00 PT / 03:00 ET).

Complete daily missions and get the most out of each battle to collect a whole load of candy. Advancing along the marathon route depends directly on the amount of candy you have. Every candy piece you earn moves you closer to the coveted reward!

You can get candy by participating in battles and completing daily missions:

 Easy daily mission – 3 pieces of candy
 Average daily mission – 6 pieces of candy
 Difficult daily mission – 9 pieces of candy
 Over 8,000 personal points earned in a single battle will grant you +1 candy

Certificates within the Holiday Maneuvers event will be available for purchase in the Premium Shop from 05:00 PT / 08:00 ET on December 15.

If there is candy left after getting all the rewards, it will be converted into Free XP at a rate of 100 Free XP points for 1 piece of candy.

notes.title: Update 2.1.10
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/25bcee0bf794ad45c9afa5d21d5de6cdcd517716.jpg

On November 3, from 01:00 PT / 04:00 ET to 05:00 PT / 08:00 ET, the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy the 2.1.10 update.


Aircraft
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/678505cf33ba9f56504683af1643c9e5c2bf9276.jpg

Update 2.1.10 introduces the brand-new special reward aircraft:
 Potez 540 – a French (Europe) Tier III bomber.
An air cruiser of the first half of the 1930s. Was called up to perform a wide range of missions: from reconnaissance to strikes on enemy positions. Proved successful in the early stages of the Spanish Civil War. By the beginning of active hostilities against Germany, the planes were considered obsolete and removed from combat units.

You can obtain this aircraft by completing special missions dedicated to the World of Warplanes' anniversary.

Aircraft Balance Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/9ea3bd65bc0efc718efe1ca239797beb9509fe2d.png

 The following changes have been applied for all the Tier IX – X bombers:
 Reduced acceleration in dive.
 Increased speed loss when maneuvering in a dive.
 Reduced maneuverability in a dive and roll maneuverability.
 Significantly reduced cruise and top speed at non-optimal altitudes.
 Reduced maneuverability at non-optimal altitudes.  Changed the chances of getting into Tier VI – VII battles for a number of Tier VI aircraft.

Other
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/8acfe469a7ff603db3e9023877bc9b38e58500bf.jpg

 Added themed festive emblem dedicated to the World of Warplanes' anniversary that will be available as a reward.

notes.title: Update 2.1.9
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/25bcee0bf794ad45c9afa5d21d5de6cdcd517716.jpg

On September 15, from 01:00 PT / 04:00 ET to 05:00 PT / 08:00 ET, the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy the 2.1.9 update.

Aircraft
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/678505cf33ba9f56504683af1643c9e5c2bf9276.jpg

Update 2.1.9 introduces the brand-new special reward aircraft:

Antonov M Masha – a Soviet Tier IX fighter.
This experimental aircraft was developed within the walls of the Antonov Design Bureau. The aircraft is equipped with four 23 mm aircraft guns that will allow it to hit any type of aerial targets. The original aerodynamic configuration provides an advantage in maneuverability in boundary flight conditions at maximum or extremely low speeds.

You can obtain this war machine by completing special missions scheduled for late September.

New Supply Crate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/b8acf927eb3ea2cbb132d3957e1e725a0152a7b6.png

Hawk Supply crates will be added to the game. They will include three guaranteed prizes:  days of Premium Account,  Premium aircraft,  gold,  Free XP,  equipment,  experimental equipment,  pilots with free skill points, and  materials!

In addition, we have implemented a mechanism for one-time compensation with in-game gold in the case the dropped aircraft is already available in the account.

Equipment
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/793edbf198cdcc063f391ed5f810b2a1fbb3d818.jpg

New experimental equipment has been added:

 Experimental Reinforced Airframe (Period II, III)
 Experimental Long Gun Barrels (Periods I, II, III)

Bug Fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/9ea3bd65bc0efc718efe1ca239797beb9509fe2d.png

 Fixed the issue when the Aerodynamics Expert skill in combination with the G-Suit equipment did not affect the maneuverability characteristics in the Hangar.
 Fixed the issue of rounding the influence of effects from equipment and pilot skills on aircraft characteristics. Now the characteristics in the Hangar correspond to the characteristics in battle.

Other
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/8acfe469a7ff603db3e9023877bc9b38e58500bf.jpg

 Added paint scheme, nose art, and emblem for the brand-new Antonov M Masha Soviet fighter. These elements will also be available as a reward.

notes.title: Boeing B-29C Superfortress and July Deals
notes.content:
Boeing B-29C Superfortress: Start your engines!

Update 2.1.7 introduces the brand-new aircraft –  Boeing B-29C Superfortress!

This modification of the legendary strategic B-29C Superfortress bomber inherits the characteristic features of the previous representatives of the US bomber aviation and will become a worthy representative of this aircraft class. The Superfortress is equipped with more powerful engines than previous models, which allows you to control the battlefield more effectively. The warplane's specialization is carpet bombing. The combat load is forty 500 lb bombs, placed in two bomb doors, that is enough for two salvos. Improved defensive armament allows you to effectively repel enemy attacks with less risk to the crew.

From July 2 (04:20 PT / 07:20 ET) to August 2 (04:20 PT / 07:20 ET), complete the chain of 30 missions to receive not only the Boeing B-29C Superfortress, but also the decorations set (paint scheme, nose art, emblem) for your new aircraft!

Note

 You may skip combat missions of the marathon by purchasing certificates in the Premium Shop;
 Only Tier IV – X aircraft can take part in the event.


You can find more details about the chain of missions on our official portal!

Keep completing marathon missions on your favorite warbirds to grab all the event's rewards! Don't have time to complete all the missions? Just visit the Premium Shop and purchase certificates to speed up the completion of the in-game event!

notes.title: Update 2.1.6
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/25bcee0bf794ad45c9afa5d21d5de6cdcd517716.jpg

On June 30, from 00:00 PT / 03:00 ET to 04:00 PT / 07:00 ET, the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy the 2.1.7 update.

Aircraft
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/678505cf33ba9f56504683af1643c9e5c2bf9276.jpg

The first summer 2021 update introduces the brand-new Premium aircraft – Boeing B-29C Superfortress, an American Tier VIII bomber.

This modification of the legendary strategic B-29C Superfortress bomber inherits the characteristic features of the previous representatives of the US bomber aviation and will become a worthy representative of this aircraft class. The Superfortress is equipped with more powerful engines than previous models, which allows you to control the battlefield more effectively. The warplane's specialization is carpet bombing. The combat load is forty 500 lb bombs, placed in two bomb doors, that is enough for two salvos. Improved defensive armament allows you to effectively repel enemy attacks with less risk to the crew.

You may add the Boeing B-29C Superfortress to your Hangar within the in-game event that starts a few days after the update is released.

In-game Event
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/b724d00357f67d2f045d195ceb5c53db83843de7.jpg

On July 2, an in-game event will begin, taking part in which you will have the opportunity to become the owner of the brand-new Boeing B-29С Superfortress. Upon completing the chain of combat missions, you will receive a premium bomber and other valuable prizes. It will also be possible to skip combat missions for certificates.

New Supply Crate (Trophy)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/e2da15e3ed2e3cfb4d53ec560c0c4645c9135a01.png

Gyrfalcon Trophies will be added to the game. They will include three guaranteed prizes:  days of Premium Account,  Premium aircraft,  gold,  Free XP,  consumables,  experimental equipment,  pilots with free skill points, and  materials!

In addition, we have implemented a mechanism for one-time compensation with in-game gold in the case the dropped aircraft is already available in the account.

Creating a Flight
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/4c16d415f87fa94d0db08d1ec080d078898f8d20.jpg

Update 2.1.7 changes the approach of creating flights. Now players can only create a flight from aircraft of the same tier.

Bug Fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/793edbf198cdcc063f391ed5f810b2a1fbb3d818.jpg

 Fixed a bug with with displaying some emblems on the Grumman F5F Skyrocket.
 Added the possibility to put themed national emblems on the Vultee XP-54 Swoose Goose

Displaying the Number of Certificates on the Account
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/8acfe469a7ff603db3e9023877bc9b38e58500bf.jpg

The number of certificates is now displayed on the player's account. Now, after the end of the activities, certificates will not be compensated with in-game gold, but will remain on the account and can be used in future in-game events.

notes.title: Vultee XP-54 Swoose Goose: Start your engines!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/2ae48db90548208fa1506f8b7494e9962cdeeede.png

This war machine was developed as a modern interceptor with high flight characteristics for the U.S. Army Air Force. Powerful and accurate forward-firing weapons are designed to confidently destroy targets at any distance. The unique experimental design retains the ability to maneuver at critical speed. The high speed of a heavy fighter, coupled with other advantages, makes the XP-54 an excellent interceptor.

To add this heavy fighter to your Hangar, you need to execute missions from the special operation order. You can receive this order from trophies available in the Supply Service for 750 gold. You can also receive it as a reward for completing the personal combat missions within the Flaming Hawk event.


 You can purchase special supply crates in the Supply Service from May 20 (04:20 PT / 07:20 ET) to June 18 (04:20 PT / 07:20 ET).
 You can activate your operation order until June 18, 2021 (04:20 PT / 07:20 ET).
 Missions within the operation order can be executed until June 20, 2021 (04:20 PT / 07:20 ET).


A chain of 20 missions awaits you. Upon completing these missions, which you will receive not only the Vultee XP-54 Swoose Goose, but also the decorations set (camouflage, nose art, emblem) for your new aircraft!

You can skip several operations or the whole chain by purchasing certificates in the Premium Shop.

Those who are unable to fulfill the operation conditions within the allocated time will be able to reanimate the operation without losing their mission progress using Tokens.

Check our official portal for more details!

Certificates for the Vultee XP-54 Swoose Goose

Keep completing marathon missions to grab all the event's rewards! Don't have time to complete all the missions? Just visit the Premium Shop and purchase certificates to speed up the completion of the in-game event!

The certificates will be available in the Premium Shop from May 20 (04:20 PT / 07:20 ET) till June 20 (04:20 PT / 07:20 ET).

Visit our official site for more information!

notes.title: Flaming Hawk
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/2ae48db90548208fa1506f8b7494e9962cdeeede.png

From May 17 to June 20, join the in-game event to add the brand-new Vultee XP-54 Swoose Goose to your Hangar!

General information
The Flaming Hawk in-game event will take place from May 17 to June 20. The event will be divided into four stages. Each stage will contain two identical phases, during which you will have to fight in several battle modes: Bomber Escort, Conquest, and Attrition.

Only aircraft of Tiers IV-X can take part in the event.

 First phase of each stage: from Thursday 17:00 PT / 20:00 ET till Friday 23:00 PT / 02:00 ET.
 Second phase of each stage: from Saturday 17:00 PT / 20:00 ET till Sunday 23:00 PT / 02:00 ET.

Note: daily missions can be completed only in the Conquest mode.

Missions

During each phase, you will have to complete:

 3 personal missions for each aircraft type. You will earn gold and supply crates by completing the missions

On April 28th, from 01:00 PT / 04:00 ET to 05:00 PT / 08:00 ET, the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy the 2.1.6 update.

On February 10, from 00:00 PT / 03:00 ET to 04:00 PT / 07:00 ET, the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy the 2.1.4 update.

Crew
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/85fc0d752cabdd8e9083a03750381e3e4bd7aaaa.png

Update 2.1.4 introduces two new unique pilots to the game, as well as an in-game event allowing you to receive these pilots.

Unique pilots have been added. You can receive them very soon by completing the chain of combat missions:

 Soviet pilot Vasiliy Pavlov, trained for the Lavochkin La-5 aircraft. This pilot not only allows you to survive longer in battle thanks to the decreased risk of fire and damage taken form AA guns, but also has perfectly mastered the control of the legendary La-5 aircraft, seriously improving its characteristics.
 Japanese pilot Akira Akane, trained for the Mitsubishi A6M5 Zero aircraft. An inborn samurai, aimed at dealing maximum damage to enemy planes, not only on the A6M5, but also on other Japanese aircraft.


 Each pilot belongs to a certain nation and has a specialization, i.e. pre-trained for a specific aircraft.
 Unlike the standard skills set, each pilot has two unique skills:

 New skills have special names and replace the two passive abilities of standard pilots.
 One skill is tied to the aircraft the pilot was originally trained for and will not work when retraining to another aircraft.
 The second skill is universal and will work on any aircraft.
 Unique skills cannot be reset, i.e. pilots always have them and points are always put in them according to value.

notes.title: Crimson Dawn
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/5cfd8af7389b3c1d1f2e78e654b3332a567fb272.png

From November 19 to December 20, join the in-game event to add the brand-new heavy fighter to your Hangar: Grumman F5F Skyrocket!

General information
The Crimson Dawn event will last from November 19 till December 20. The event will be divided into four stages, each stage will contain two identical phases, during which you will have to fight in several battle modes: Bomber Escort, Conquest, Invasion, and Attrition.

Only aircraft of Tiers IV-X can take part in the event.

 First phase of each stage: from Thursday 17:00 PT / 20:00 ET till Friday 23:00 PT / 02:00 ET.
 Second phase of each stage: from Saturday 17:00 PT / 20:00 ET till Sunday 23:00 PT / 02:00 ET.

Note: daily missions can be completed only in the Conquest mode.

Missions

During each phase, you will have to complete:

 3 personal missions for each aircraft type. You will earn gold and supply crates by completing the missions
 One global mission for all players. Upon completing this mission, you will double the number of supply crates earned, which contain valuable rewards.

The progress of personal and global missions is reset after the completion of each phase.

notes.title: Update 2.1.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/25bcee0bf794ad45c9afa5d21d5de6cdcd517716.jpg

On November 9, from 00:00 PT / 03:00 ET to 04:00 PT / 07:00 ET the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy Update 2.1.

Update 2.1.2 introduces the American Grumman F5F Skyrocket heavy fighter, new experimental equipment, a unique supply crate, as well as an increased chance of reward drops for existing supply crates.

From November 16, the game will host the Crimson Dawn global event. Here you will see the return of the Bomber Escort, Invasion, and Attrition modes in which you try to achieve a common goal together with the other players. Reaching this goal will double the number of supply crates that you can receive. In these supply crates, you can find operation orders to obtain the brand-new heavy fighter as well as many other rewards.

New Aircraft

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/2a105be658b19d91dd9406840e8f47fd57098b08.jpg

New Special Reward Aircraft:

 Grumman F5F Skyrocket – an American Tier V heavy fighter


The Grumman F5F Skyrocket is a nimble and maneuverable American heavy fighter. The high speed characteristics help this aircraft immediately intercept most targets. At the same time, the maneuverability of the F5F is closer to lighter aircraft, which makes it much more comfortable when performing maneuvers. The armament requires accuracy when firing and allows hitting targets at medium distances.

The Crimson Dawn Event

Equipment

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/9ea3bd65bc0efc718efe1ca239797beb9509fe2d.png

Three new types of experimental equipment

 Experimental Turret Armor Protection (Period I, II, III)
 Experimental Polished Skin (Period I, II, III)
 Experimental Bolt Carriers (Period II, III)



Other Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/8acfe469a7ff603db3e9023877bc9b38e58500bf.jpg

 A festive Hangar dedicated to the game's anniversary has been added.
 A festive emblem that may be received during the anniversary special has been added.
 There is an increased chance for gold, days of Premium Account, and Free XP to drop from all types of supply crates.
 A special supply crate within the Crimson Dawn event has been added.
 There is updated information on the loading screen.

On Track to Yak-7-M-82
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/c5296bc889af06aed0548bc7946de3551f90c6be.png

From December 20 (01:30 PT / 04:30 ET) till January 6 (01:30 PT / 04:30 ET), your collection of aircraft can be expanded with a new legendary warbird.

This Tier V aircraft is known as the Yakovlev Yak-7 M-82!

Yak-7 M-82 offers the broadest choice of battle tactics. You never know what to expect from it: six rockets can cause considerable damage to ground targets, and its powerful machine gun and autocannon armament are sure to deal critical damage!

Will you suit each other? To find out, you’ll need to beat the series of mission standing between you and the warbird!

notes.title: Horten Ho 229 Special Bundle
notes.content:
Pilots!

From November 18 till December 1, this rare German fighter will spread its wings in the Premium Shop. Experience the thrill of battle with the  Horten Ho 229!

Externally, a very impressive aircraft, constructed according to the "flying wing" scheme, which can boast more than a great exterior. The fantastic speed performance and powerful boost allow it to move swiftly around the battlefield and quickly change altitude range. A pair of long-range 30 mm guns make this warbird a perfect hunter of almost any target – its sniper fire allows it to destroy even a bomber in one pass!

Ho-229 Basic

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592511/f1c3e4e3c77644d3f2524f55b3e36e2247f1d761.jpg

notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/75b5c6a57582691beb0015bdd42fb942199b7bbf.png

NA
On July 10 from 23:00 PT / July 11 02:00 ET till July 11 03:00 PT / 06:00 ET the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy Update 2.1.

EU
On July 11 from 08:00 CEST, UTC+2 till 12:00 CEST, UTC+2 the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy Update 2.1.

Update 2.1 brings new aircraft from the countries that haven't featured in the game before — Czechoslovakia, Poland, Sweden, and Israel. With the addition of these countries, the French Tech Tree will be transformed into united Europe, where all new nations' representatives will be found.

The update also introduces new personal ratings with an opportunity to get unique pieces of equipment, consumables, gold, tokens, and materials. All map layouts for all battle modes have been added to the training room, including Attrition, Invasion, and Bomber Escort. Now players will be able to hone their tactics for any battle mode.

New Aircraft

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/678505cf33ba9f56504683af1643c9e5c2bf9276.jpg

The following aircraft are now available for purchase in the in-game shop:

 Avia Bk-534, а Czechoslovakian (European) Tier III fighter
 PZL P-38 Wilk, а Polish (European) Tier III heavy fighter
 Avia S-199, an Israeli (European) Tier VI multirole fighter
 SAAB J 21RB, a Swedish (European) Tier VIII multirole fighter

New Special Reward Aircraft:

 Avia B-534, а Czechoslovakian (European) Tier III fighter
 Yak-7 M-82 A, a Soviet Tier V multirole fighter
 P-82B Twin Mustang, an American Tier VIII heavy fighter


United Europe

With the addition of new nations, the France tab in the Tech Tree was transformed into Europe, and that's where the Premium aircraft of France, Czechoslovakia, Poland, Sweden, and Israel are now located.

Switching Aircraft Nation
You can now switch the nation of any European aircraft (including French machines that were available before) to any of the main nations (Germany, U.S.S.R., U.S.A., U.K., or Japan) and back.

With this option, you can use these aircraft to train other nations' Crews or assign already trained Crews to them.

Equipment
New equipment added only for the Period III aircraft — G-Suit. It's installed in the cockpit slot and increases an aircraft's maneuverability at high speed while sacrificing the pilot's resistance to critical damage. This equipment can be purchased using credits in the game client.

 G-Suit — maneuverability at high speed +6–14%, pilot's resistance to injuries –3–10%. Bonus characteristics: maneuverability in pitch +0.5%, accuracy when firing at moving targets +5%, maneuverability in pitch +1%, maximum altitude +4%, maneuverability at high speed +3%, maximum altitude +6%.

New Unique Equipment

 Special project of Japan: Lightweight Power Unit — yaw maneuverability +3–12.6%, maneuverability in pitch +1.5–4.7%, engine's resistance to critical damage –2–10.4%. Bonus characteristics: cruise speed +0.5%, acceleration without boost +1%, cruise speed +1%, acceleration with boost +1%, acceleration without boost +0.5%, acceleration with boost +0.5%.
 Special project of the U.S.A.: Reinforced Bolt Carriers — burst length of forward-firing offensive armament +3–35%, accuracy of forward-firing offensive armament –2–10.4%. Bonus characteristics: cooldown rate of forward-firing offensive armament +5%, rate of fire of forward-firing offensive armament +2%, rate of fire of forward-firing offensive armament +5%, cooldown rate of forward-firing offensive armament +10%, firing range of forward-firing offensive armament +3%, rate of fire of forward-firing offensive armament +3%.

Personal Ratings

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/1ed56ddbe10ef3d9a8ea0591492d02db15a5f622.jpg

The update's release brings the new ratings that will last for 4 weeks.

By participating in battles and fulfilling the conditions for getting into the rating for each of the weeks, players will be added to one of five divisions and, on Wednesday, will receive prizes corresponding to their effectiveness — unique equipment that can be received only by participating in the rating, gold, consumables, and much more. Each of the ratings will last for six days, from Thursday (16:00 UTC) till Tuesday (20:00 UTC).

Interface


 Fixed a bug that caused the lock icon to disappear on the sectors unavailable for capture.
 Fixed a bug that caused the stats of an aircraft selected in the carousel that has been upgraded due to the installed equipment, to be projected to other machines' info in the Hangar. This bug didn't affect the real battle stats of the aircraft.
 Added more options to the stat panel in the Hangar. Now the panel correctly shows how the Crew skills affect the aircraft's performance. By hovering the mouse over different modules, you can see how the performance will be changed if they are installed. Besides, the pop-up hints were added that explain the sources and values of the effects that influence an aircraft's stats.

Graphics

The lighting system was updated for all locations. Now the game utilizes the atmospheric light diffusion system, which makes the game's visuals more realistic.

Other Changes

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/8acfe469a7ff603db3e9023877bc9b38e58500bf.jpg

Game Modes:

 All map layouts for the Attrition, Invasion, and Bomber Escort battle modes have been added to the training room
.
Bots:

 Fixed a bug that made it possible for the bot to be sent to defend itself with a shortcut.
 Increased the minimum distance needed to assign a bot on an attack aircraft to defend a player's aircraft.

Controls:

 Gamepad support restored.

notes.title: Update 2.0.13
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/c95a2a2b86365d593f7cd22a0a7789503ad6c6d4.png

NA
On June 5 from 23:00 PT / June 6 02:00 ET till June 6 03:00 PT / 06:00 ET the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy the 2.0.13 update. 

EU
On June 6 from 08:00 CEST (UTC+2) till 12:00 CEST (UTC+2) the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy the 2.0.13 update.

Spring Campaign Wrap-up
Update 2.0.13 will draw a line under the spring campaign.

Campaign participants with the corresponding achievements will be able to research and purchase the Tier X Su-10 and EF-131 bombers with a significant discount (up to 80% depending on the number of achievements earned during the spring campaign). In addition, those who managed to earn all 10 of the campaign's achievements will receive pilots for the Su-10 and EF-131 with 5 free skill points. If some of the steps were missed, you will have an opportunity to catch up and increase your discount by completing 10 special missions. You can also skip any mission in a chain using tokens. Upon completing these missions players will also receive Supply crates with additional prizes.

Players that received a stage medal but did not complete the third mission (Service Award) of any campaign stage and, accordingly, did not receive a Supply crate as a reward, will receive the same number of one-hour boosters (up to 8). Players who earned the Master of Vengeance or Red Falcon achievements will also receive a one-hour booster for each achievement.

Daily Bonus
Added a system of rewards and prizes for those who regularly play World of Warplanes.

Every day, when you first enter the game, you will receive a small credit bonus and a simple daily mission. Upon completing this mission, you will receive a daily reward (it includes equipment, calibration materials, and ammunition). After completing all daily missions for 7 days in a row, you will receive a valuable prize that might contain gold, Free XP, Premium aircraft, and other rewards.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/678505cf33ba9f56504683af1643c9e5c2bf9276.jpg

New Aircraft

U.S.S.R. and German Bombers

 Tier VII-X aircraft of the U.S.S.R. bombers branch (Tu-2, Tu-10, Tu-12, Su-10), and Tier X aircraft of the German bombers branch (EF-131) are now available for research and purchase via the Tech Tree.

New Special Reward Aircraft

 Horten Ho 229 — a German Tier VIII fighter.

Aircraft Balance

 Updated damage models for the following aircraft: F-84B, F-84F, Fw 252, Ta 183, Me P.1092, Me P.1101.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/99f66dc01d6e4869681031520a2329256986f26b.png

Secret Trials: Horten Ho 229
Update 2.0.13 brings players the opportunity to take part in the secret trials of the brand-new Tier VIII German Horten Ho 229 fighter. 

To add the Horten Ho 229 to your Hangar, you need to execute the special Secret Trials operation. You can activate it for free in the Supply Service. You can skip several operations or the whole chain by purchasing certificates in the Premium Shop. Also now, if the time for the operation's execution has expired, but not all the missions have been completed, you can resume their execution using Tokens.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/1ed56ddbe10ef3d9a8ea0591492d02db15a5f622.jpg

Personal Ratings
The update's release brings the new ratings that will last for 4 weeks.

By participating in battles and fulfilling the conditions for getting into the rating for each of the weeks, players will be added to one of five divisions and, on Wednesday, will receive prizes corresponding to their effectiveness — unique equipment that can be received only by participating in the rating, consumables, and much more.

New Equipment

 Special project of Germany: Engine Boost Mixture Injection System and Special project of Germany: High-Speed Gas Turbine — acceleration with boost activated 3-12.6%, maximum speed with boost activated: +1.5-6.3%, boost duration: 5-14.8%. Bonus characteristics: engine cooldown rate +4%, cruise speed: +0.5%, engine's resistance to critical damage: +10%, engine cooldown rate: +6%, engine cooldown rate: +10%, maximum speed with boost activated: +1%.
 Special project of Japan: Lightweight Wing Frame — roll maneuverability: +7-15%, maneuverability in turns: +1-4.2%, aircraft hit points: -1-5.2%, wings' resistance to critical damage: -3-10%. Bonus characteristics: wings' resistance to critical damage: +3%, yaw maneuverability: +0.5%, roll maneuverability: +5%, cruise speed: +1%, yaw maneuverability: +1%, maneuverability in turns: +0.5%.
 Special project of the U.K.: Collimator Sight and Special project of the U.K.: Gyroscopic Sight — accuracy of forward-firing offensive armament: +7-23%, pilot's resistance to injuries: -2-16%. Bonus characteristics: chance of inflicting critical damage: +7%, chance of causing a fire: +10%, chance of inflicting critical damage: +10%, accuracy when firing at moving targets: +5%, accuracy when firing at moving targets: +3%, firing range of forward-firing offensive armament: +3%.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/a59e694b34708f05e7a9bd15aa040af17962f2b9.png

Bots
Updated the bots' control system via the chat shortcuts (keys F2, F3, F4, and F7).
Each player can control only one bot at a time. The bot will execute orders until one of the three following events occurs: it is destroyed; the aircraft that the bot is attacking or defending is destroyed; the sector that is the target of the bot's attack or defense passes into the hands of another team.
After the player uses the chat shortcut, the order will be assigned to the bot that is closest to the team's target and piloting a suitable aircraft. Bots that are already executing any other player’s order will ignore the new order. If there is not a single suitable free bot, the order will be declined. If the bot is attacked on the way to its target, it can join the battle to defend itself, and this will postpone the order's execution.

 Upon pressing the F2 key, a player sends one suitable bot to the selected sector (when attacking) or calls it to assist with defending the sector (a player must be in that sector). The bot goes there and starts attacking the targets corresponding to the target's aircraft type. The territory type affects the bot's choice, for example, fighters are not involved in attacking plants, and attack aircraft and bombers will not provide support when defending sectors.
 Upon pressing the F3 key, a player calls a bot that will become a Flight member and provide support for this player. The choice of the bot depends on what the player is currently engaged in — the attack aircraft type can provide support when attacking sectors; outside these sectors, a player can order fighters to provide cover.
 Upon pressing the F4 key, a player can order a bot that is piloting an attack aircraft type to engage a selected enemy aircraft or to defend a selected allied aerial target. In addition, you can order the bot to defend the allied Attack Flight.
 Upon pressing the F7 key ("Clear my Tail!"), a player can order a bot that is piloting a fighter aircraft type to attack all aerial targets threatening the player.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/945a96c5c5bcad83cec7d99025b592bce7a6a33b.jpg

Maps
Changed some map layouts for low tier battles:

 Sea Gate: Siege, Old Fortress: Enemy at the Gates, Old Fortress: Flanking Maneuver — changed entry points for both teams.
 Old Fortress: Danger Zone — completely changed entry points, as well as territory type and layout.


Interface
An indication of the number of players and bots waiting at specific entry points has been added to the respawn window.

Sound
Hangar sound effects were significantly updated and enhanced.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/8acfe469a7ff603db3e9023877bc9b38e58500bf.jpg

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug due to which some gift emblems on the Ju 86 E, Hs 129 A, and BV P. 203 aircraft did not provide bonuses.
 Fixed a bug due to which rear turret fire visual effects on the Тu-2 and Тu-10 were missing.
 Fixed a bug with the gunner's model on the AD10 aircraft.

notes.title: Get a Tier X bomber at an 80% discount!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/c95a2a2b86365d593f7cd22a0a7789503ad6c6d4.png

Pilots, it's time to take stock of the results of the Spring campaign!

During the Blade of Vengeance and Red Comet events, you proved that you're true aces! Great job!

Now it's time to learn how the rewards you have earned will help you get one of the two bombers (of your choosing):

 the Su-10 
or
 EF-131

The number of rewards you earned during the Spring campaign determines your personal discount on researching and purchasing the Su-10 or EF-131!

If you fought actively during the Blade of Vengeance and Red Comet events and have already got all 10 achievements, then congratulations! The maximum discount on a bomber awaits you!

Didn't get any medals? No big deal!
Every pilot has an opportunity to purchase a bomber at a discount of up to 80%!

You can only use your discount once. You decide what to put into your Hangar: the Su-10 or EF-131.

If you have a German or Soviet Tier IX bomber, you can use the XP gained on it to research a Tier X aircraft at a discount. If you don't have those aircraft, you can use Free XP.

That's why we're offering special missions to those who didn't get event medals. By completing these missions you bump up your discount!

notes.title: Update 2.0.12
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/00e220553b7915de7cde6b58481d9a8d53296953.png

On April 25 from 01:00 PT / 04:00 ET till 05:00 PT / 08:00 ET, the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy the 2.0.12 update.

Update 2.0.12 marks the start of the final half of the Spring Campaign — the Red Comet special.

Allied air forces will deal a crippling blow to the German offensive in Europe which started during the Sword of Vengeance special. In Red Comet our players will get a chance to try new Soviet high-tier bombers — the Tupolev Tu-2, Tu-10, Tu-12 and Sukhoy Su-10. These fast, maneuverable machines are equipped with forward-facing armament and differ quite a bit from other bombers in the game. They are capable of not only crushing ground targets from high altitudes, but also pose considerable danger to enemy aircraft in aerial combat.

In-game visibility system has been changed to improve effectiveness of concealing paint schemes and Navigational Radio Equipment, as well as improve enemy detection ranges on maps with dense cloud cover.

Several crossings between branches in U.S.S.R., German and U.S.A. tech trees have been changed. Balance settings for a number of aircraft have been slightly tuned.

Additionally, we fixed multiple issues with maps, aircraft visuals in battle and Hangar.

New Aircraft

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/2a105be658b19d91dd9406840e8f47fd57098b08.jpg

 Tupolev Tu-2 — a Soviet Tier VII bomber;
 Tupolev Tu-10 — a Soviet Tier VIII bomber;
 Tupolev Tu-12 — a Soviet Tier IX bomber;
 Sukhoy Su-10 — a Soviet, Tier X bomber.

The Tier VII-IX part of the U.S.S.R. bombers branch is represented by Tupolev Tu-2 and its successors the Tu-10 and Tu-12. These warplanes are quite similar in features and playstyle, with later models being in fact evolutions upon the most successful Soviet frontline bomber design of the World War II - the Tu-2. The concept of a bomber capable of aerial combat at low and medium altitudes due to powerful forward-facing and defensive armament is obvious in Tupolev machines. From Tier to Tier these aircraft gain improved flight characteristics but retain similar feel and playstyle.

The branch is crowned by the Sukhoy Su-10, also known as Product E. In contrast with the Tu-12 which was an intermediary design between piston-driven and jet-powered bombers, the Su-10 was initially conceived as a jet aircraft. It is faster, has better altitude performance, more powerful armament, and carries eight 500-kg bombs. Firepower from two twin-linked 20-mm cannons in its turrets will make attacking the Su-10 from rear hemisphere fatal for most fighters.

Tier VII-IX aircraft will be available through Special Orders that players can find in Trophies and complete during the Red Comet special. The Sukhoy Su-10 and its rival, the Junkers EF 131, will become available for research and purchase after the Spring Campaign is concluded, and all the players who participated and received multiple achievements in it will get a large discount to both XP and credit requirements. The full branch will become available for regular research after the Red Comet special. In the meantime the Su-10 and EF 131 can be encountered in battles piloted by bots.

The following aircraft is now available for purchase in the premium shop:

 Ilyushin Il-1 — a Soviet Tier VI multirole fighter;
 Dornier Do 335 A-1 Pfeil — a German Tier VIII heavy fighter.

The following promotional aircraft has been added:

 Bristol Beaufighter Mk V IM — a British Tier V heavy figher.

Economy

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/e030de980b5c5ffd6f20330a359bcbdff8f10495.jpg

Reduced prices in experience for Tiers VIII-X aircraft upgrades:

Tier VIII:

 15% off the modules
 25% off the aircraft

Tier IX:

 20% off the modules
 30% off the aircraft

Tier X:

 25% off the modules
 30% off the aircraft


Balance

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/b724d00357f67d2f045d195ceb5c53db83843de7.jpg

Aircraft Balance Changes

Visibility changes
The settings of the aircraft visibility system have been changed in order to increase the utility of using concealing paint schemes, as well as the effect of the new Navigational Radio Equipment:

The use of seasonal concealing paint schemes (summer, winter, desert, marine) with the effect of +20% to aircraft concealment on the corresponding map types will reduce the distance of the aircraft's detection by an average of 200 m for aircraft of all Tiers. The use of Navigational Radio Equipment can further increase this effect up to 500 m. These changes will not influence other paint schemes' effects (protection from AA guns and gunners).
Clouds' concealment effect slightly decreased. This will increase the comfort of playing on maps with dense clouds. However, the clouds' concealment effect will remain quite significant and will reduce the detection distance by an average of 200 m.
In cases when there are no concealment effects and no crew skills or equipment increasing the view range, the detection range will be approximately 1,650 m for Tier I-IV aircraft, 2,000 m for Tier V-VII aircraft, and 2,500 m for Tier VIII-X aircraft. Like before, the detection range will be equal for all aircraft types.

Visible area on the Radar now covers 4500 / 3000 / 1500 meters for Tiers I-IV, 6000 / 4000 / 2000m for Tiers V-VII and 7500 / 5000 / 2500m for Tiers VIII-X. A circle visible on the radar when Alt is pressed represents average distance of enemy detection for the aircraft Tier. If an enemy is inside that circle it most probably can see the player's aircraft as well.

Flight model

Aircraft behavior in stall has been changed. Stall will now become more controlled and easy to recover from.

Changes in tech trees

USSR

 Temporary crossing between bomber and attack aircraft branches between Pe-2 M-82 and Il-8 is no longer available.

Germany

 Fw 190 A-1 can now be researched from He 112 and Bf 109 E.
 Ta 152 can now be researched from Fw 190 D and Bf 109 G.

USA

 F6U can now be researched from P-51H and provides an cannon-based alternative to American fighters mostly armed with machineguns. It will also serve as a link for crossing over to the heavy fighter branch towards the F2H.

Balance changes for some aircraft

USSR

 Il-20 — slightly reduced damage and blast radius of the TRS-82 rockets.
 RB-17 — all 4 engines can now be damaged individually.
 Il-40P — fixed an error in the turret damage settings for Specialist configuration. It will now deal more damage.

Germany

 Bf 109 G — increased armament accuracy, slightly increased boost efficiency and duration.

Great Britain

 Beaufighter — updated damage model, slightly decreased salvo duration for forward-facing armament.

Game modes

Settings for bomber waves in Escort game mode have been changed. Their HP count was increased for all battle Tiers. Numbers of bombers in waves and waves themselves have been rebalanced for all map layouts (increased for some and decreased for others).

New map layouts

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/e3ea545854d04af3b879e191b735fe91b1e26e01.jpg

Added 5 new map layouts based on Plateau map for Conquest game mode Tier VII-X battles:

 Surprise attack,
 Sandstorm,
 Cursed valley,
 Deserted fortress,
 Blazing sky.

Paint schemes

Added unique paint schemes for a number of aircraft from regular research trees to the Hangar "Paint Shop" tab.

These were previously only available as part of rewards for completing Special Orders or prizes for in-game events. Same as all the other non-concealing paint schemes, these provide +5% bonus to aircraft XP gain in battles.

The list of aircraft is as follows:

 Dornier Do 17 Z
 Junkers Ju 88 A
 Dornier Do 217 M
 Arkhangelsky/Tupolev SB
 Arkhangelsky Ar-2
 Petlyakov Pe-2
 Petlyakov Pe-2 M-82
 Boeing B-17D
 Boeing B-17G
 Consolidated B-32
 Kawasaki Ki-45
 Kawasaki Ki-102
 Rikugun Ki-93
 Hawker Tornado
 Hawker Typhoon
 Hawker Tempest
 Hawker Sea Hawk

Bug Fixes

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/8acfe469a7ff603db3e9023877bc9b38e58500bf.jpg

 Fixed an issue that caused a respawn point different from the default one to revert to the default one in case the enemy team captured any allied territory while the player waited for respawn. It will now only revert to the default respawn point if the enemy team captures the territory selected for respawn.
 Fixed an incorrect spawn point for bombers on Northern Bridgehead: Cold Skies map layout so that they no longer spawn facing a mountain peak.
 Fixed an issue with AA guns not attacking enemies on several map layouts.
 Fixed an issue with Scorching Sands: Desert Strike map layout that caused one of the bombers to spawn among enemy team.
 Fixed engine power value for the Jumo 004A engine in the Hangar tooltip. Aircraft parameters have not changed.
 Fixed an issue with the XP-31 pilot model that caused the oxygen mask to shift in some cases.
 Fixed an issue with a reward paint scheme for the Hurricane Mk. I that caused its engine cover to lose metallic sheen.
 Fixed an issue that caused propeller speed visualization to not return to normal after engine critical damage and repair.
 Fixed a minor issue with the B-32 bomb bay doors animation.
